title: Lightbox Animation: VFX Supervisor
text: Headquarters: Córdoba, Andalusia, Spain URL: https://lbox.es Your mission Knock, knock...Any Lightboxer in the room? If you are passionate about 3D animated films and want to create magic cinematographic, you can´t let this opportunity go! We are looking for a talented VFX Supervisor with enthusiasm to join our great team on the exciting new project, Animated Feature TAD 4!! You will be responsible for leading VFX teams and coordinating with all levels of production, for design and create elements and visual effects. First of all, you're probably interested in knowing that...we offer 100% remote work! WE NEED YOU TO BE ABLE TO DO: Responsible for ensuring the VFX Artists create a wide range of high quality visual effects. Make sure that visual effects look believable and consistent with the style of the animation. Maximize the project's visual spectacularity. Optimize effects for performance while retaining look. Work closely with the Director to maintain visual consistency and with the rest of the VFX pipeline to create seamless integration into shots. Find the best technical and creative solutions in order to meet production needs. Be up to date on current and emerging visual effect trends and technology so you can contribute to new techniques and workflows. Globally responsible for quality control across the VFX Artists. Work closely with the Department Managers to optimize team schedules and scene assignments to achieve master scheduled deliverables. Continue to work as the film goes into production to ensure animated scenes remain on design. Deep knowledge on how visual effects affect the animation pipeline. Ability to work autonomously and independently in a fully remote environment, with that comes the supreme individual responsibility to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and maintain your own initiative. Excellent communication skills. Great team player, create a collaborative and welcoming environment. Proven ability to meet deadlines, prioritize workload and within budgets, adhere to the production schedule and deliver completed assignments on time. Align with the style, sensibility of the project and the Director vision. WE WILL MAKE THE PERFECT MATCH IF YOU HAVE: 5+ years of professional experience from either animation TV series or feature animation movie. Strong experience with Houdini. Knowledge of Nuke or any other composition software is a plus. Strong visual awareness and artistic ability, having a good eye for composition, color, light and shadow. Develop tools used in FX to enhance pipeline and ability to execute systems developed by other FX artists. Ability to create streamlined set ups that can be used by the rest of the team. Ability to take feedback constructively and implement it effectively, to reach the quality desired. Anticipation and quick reaction for problem solving. Demonstrate great autonomy and proactivity in your work. Great attention to detail. Outstanding interpersonal and collaborative skills. You will be the perfect Supervisor if: Proven and extensive professional experience as VFX team leadership. Ensure the team completes work under Director’s vision. Bring strong emotional intelligence, human style of leadership and empathy building trust, respect and a supportive environment, with ability to motivate, helping team to highlight their strengths, as well provide regular feedback, deal with their growth and improvement areas. Work well under pressure. Solutions driven mindset. Strong problem-solving skills and quick in finding solutions. Excellent skills presenting feedback, simple and exhaustive. Do you think we fit? Well, keep reading. WHAT WILL YOU FIND AT LIGHTBOX? We have a GREAT TEAM, taking animation to another level! Our pillars are: Strong passion : We are proactive with a positive working attitude, we continue to create successful films that conquer children and adults, so we need the motivation and energy of the best creative minds. Behind the scenes: Lightbox has an exciting mission: to bring incredible stories to life! We are happy and proud with giving the best possible value to the projects and continue achieving success. Be a Lightboxer : We need good teammates who are generally cool people and natural collaborators. Where everyone truly helps each other to grow. We love team and fun plans to disconnect and have a good time. ​ DURING THE TRIP WE CAN OFFER YOU: We are big fan of ensuring a "people first" company culture, with a good work-life balance for our employees. 100 % remote work. Nice working schedule from 8h to 16h, Monday to Friday, with some flexibility. 22 days working days annual holidays. Lightbox is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building and promoting a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce. Do you want to join us and help us continue creating magic cinematographic? About us If you are reading this it is because we have catched your attention!!! Yes, we are Lightbox Animation Studios; an animation studio focused on creating high-quality feature films, responsible for the successful Tadeo Jones saga. OUR MISSION: Bring incredible stories to life. Continue achieving success. PASSION: Obsessed with giving our best. We carry creativity in our DNA. TEAM SPIRIT: We are a great work team, which together achieve our objectives. You already know what we do and that we can offer you an incredible opportunity… Our team continues to grow and we are looking for the best creative minds. ...ANY LIGHTBOXER IN THE ROOM? We have great projects in our hands, one of them TAD 4 and we want you to be part of our next successes. What are we looking for? TO YOU! You are not afraid of challenges, you have strong motivation and energy, you like to contribute ideas and not simply execute, and you have creativity in your DNA. If you feel like you have the soul of a Lightboxer, we want to meet you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lightbox-animation-vfx-supervisor

title: Alliants Limited: Customer Success Executive (APAC & Middle East)
text: Headquarters: Singapore, Singapore URL: https://alliants.com Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone. The role at a glance Title: Customer Success Associate Location: Remote, based in Singapore (nearby APAC time zones considered), working mostly APAC hours Compensation: £35,000 – £37,000 per year Contract: 2-year contract Team: Customer Success (APAC & Middle East pod), reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager This is an associate-level customer success role on our APAC & Middle East team, and it's built around two things. You'll be our our in-region first response. When a property hits a problem overnight UK time, you pick it up, work with the hotel team and our in-region support, and hand the UK team a clear head start — rather than the hotel waiting for London to wake up. You'll own the day-to-day relationship with our standard properties across a region of more than 120 hotels and 13 brands. That means support follow-through, re-onboarding properties that need it, and making sure every hotel gets real value from our platform. Enterprise and Growth accounts sit with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager. You'll shadow and support that work as you learn, and take on more over time; this role is the in-region contact for standard properties. Role Focus & Operating Context You'll communicate with hoteliers the way great hoteliers talk to their guests. Every message is written by you, with care. You'll work mostly in APAC hours, with some overlap into UK afternoons — more at the start. You'll sit in a small regional pod alongside Product Solutions, Support and Sales, with property teams from front office to GM as your day-to-day contacts. What you'll work on and own The overnight queue — what happens when a property's guest messaging stops at 2am in London and you're the one awake Standard property relationships — day-to-day contact with front office, guest relations, operations and GMs Re-onboarding — showing property teams how the platform works, how to configure it and how to escalate Adoption — playbooks rolled out property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites The regional read-out — a usage, adoption and support-trends dashboard reviewed monthly Clean records — accurate Salesforce data and product feedback routed to the right team What you'll bring Guest-facing experience in luxury hotel operations — front office, guest relations, guest experience or rooms division Written and spoken English to luxury-hotel standard — you know how to write to a GM A real understanding of how a property runs, shift to shift Ownership — you take a problem from first message to resolution without being chased Comfort with simple reporting and data (spreadsheets, PMS or CRM reports) Confidence explaining technology to non-technical hotel teams Based in Singapore or a nearby APAC time zone, and able to contract with Alliants from there Availability to work mostly APAC hours, with some flexibility into UK afternoons Nice to have Customer success, onboarding or account support experience at a hospitality technology company Hands-on use of Salesforce, Jira or Intercom Experience running training for hotel teams A regional language such as Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese, Bahasa or Thai To thrive in this role, you'll be someone who: Asks questions before jumping to a fix, and finds the real problem Treats every hotelier like a valued guest Uses usage data and ticket trends, not anecdote, to decide where to focus Works confidently on your own and knows when to escalate Adapts naturally across the cultures of APAC and the Middle East Wants to understand how the technology works underneath You'll be the named, same-time-zone contact for standard properties across APAC and the Middle East. You'll pick up issues raised outside UK hours, work them with the property and in-region support, and hand the UK a clear head start. You'll own tickets from standard properties alongside Support, escalating to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager when needed. You'll re-onboard properties where gaps remain after deployment, so teams use the platform with confidence. You'll roll out adoption playbooks property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites, and build localised guides and training. You'll shadow enterprise calls and pick up location-level work on Enterprise accounts as you learn. You'll track usage, adoption and support trends in a regional dashboard, with a monthly read-out. You'll flag at-risk properties early, so we keep the hotels we have. You'll keep Salesforce accurate for every property you support. You'll route product feedback and requests through Product Solutions intake. Who is Alliants and what do we do? Alliants, established in 2009, is dedicated to producing customer engagement technologies and services that pave the way for a more human, sustainable, and promising future for hospitality. At Alliants, we are all in for our people and our industry. What's in it for you? We know we all work better in an autonomous, collaborative, diverse and equitable space. To support you in becoming the best version of yourself, we offer: Remote, in region: work remotely from Singapore, mostly in APAC hours Flexible hours: once you're settled in, a late day for the UK is balanced by a later start the next day Time to learn: around six months to learn the platform, including shadowing enterprise calls A regional team: work alongside our APAC & Middle East Customer Success and Product Solutions colleagues A warm welcome: to celebrate you joining Alliants, we'll plant a Great Oak tree in your honour Alliants celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alliants-limited-customer-success-executive-apac-middle-east

title: Notice: Frequent manual updates across platforms until v1.8.0 release
text: I am aware that frequent upstream updates to Electron and Chromium (often arriving every other day) currently require users across all platforms to manually re-download and reinstall Mise Browser to keep everything running smoothly. I recognise that having to constantly reinstall updates is frustrating and disrupts your workflow. I am actively working on a comprehensive packaging overhaul for the upcoming **v1.8.0** release to streamline this process. *** * **Current status:** Upstream system Electron updates or base runtime revisions can cause runtime and ABI mismatches immediately after system upgrades. * **Current workaround:** Until v1.8.0, you must pull and reinstall the latest Mise release / package whenever Electron or system dependencies update. * **Current status:** Security patches and rapid upstream Electron cycles require manually downloading and executing the latest installer or updating the portable binary folder. * **Current workaround:** Grab the newest setup executable from the Releases page when a new release is posted to ensure Chromium security patches are applied. * **Current status:** Due to frequent runtime bumps, users must manually replace the `.app` bundle in `/Applications` with each new release build. * **Current workaround:** Download the latest DMG / archive from GitHub Releases and overwrite your existing installation. *** The **v1.8.0** release focuses directly on resolving this update friction across all operating systems: * Streamlined distribution workflows. * Improved update mechanisms to eliminate repetitive manual re-installations. * Synchronised runtime packaging so you spend time browsing rather than maintaining your browser. Testing for v1.8.0 is currently underway across all environments to guarantee stability, security, and performance. I appreciate your patience while this testing is carried out. Please hold tight and bear with me for just a little longer whilst we polish and validate v1.8.0. Thank you for testing Mise and for your continued support!
